title: Did Everyone Pick the Wrong Kanto Starter?

direction.premise: Bulbasaur was treated as the boring choice, but the original games quietly make it the smartest first pick.
direction.audiencePromise: Prove the claim with three escalating advantages, then reveal the tradeoff.
direction.openLoop: Was Bulbasaur actually Kanto's hidden easy mode?
direction.payoff: It dominates the opening and evolves fastest, but four weaknesses keep the verdict debatable.
direction.engagementQuestion: Smartest first pick or merely the safest?

voice.instructions: Energetic, confident short-form documentary narrator. Crisp pronunciation, quick pace, warm curiosity, and subtle emphasis on key facts. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: YOU PICKED THE WRONG STARTER
scenes.narration: The most ignored Kanto starter may actually be easy mode.
scenes.caption: THE ‘BORING’ STARTER WAS EASY MODE?

scenes.headline: THE FIRST TWO GYMS FAVOR IT
scenes.narration: Bulbasaur counters Brock, then walks into Misty with the answer again.
scenes.caption: BROCK FALLS. THEN MISTY.

scenes.headline: AN ADVANTAGE FROM THE MOMENT YOU CHOOSE
scenes.narration: It is the only original starter with two types from the moment you choose it.
scenes.caption: THE ONLY KANTO STARTER WITH TWO TYPES

scenes.headline: VENUSAUR ARRIVES FOUR LEVELS EARLY
scenes.narration: And Venusaur arrives at level thirty two, four levels before Charizard or Blastoise.
scenes.caption: VENUSAUR: 32 • THE OTHERS: 36

scenes.headline: EASY MODE ISN’T INVINCIBLE
scenes.narration: But four weaknesses answer back: Fire, Ice, Flying, and Psychic.
scenes.caption: FOUR WEAKNESSES CHANGE THE VERDICT

scenes.headline: SMARTEST FIRST PICK — OR JUST THE SAFEST?
scenes.narration: Smartest first pick, or merely safest? Pick a side.
scenes.caption: SMART PICK OR SAFE PICK?
